capabilities: Highlight 1C (BSL) code blocks in reading and editing modes
Recognize 1c, bsl and os code block tags
Color keywords, global context methods, literals and preprocessor directives
Follow the reference 1c-syntax grammar token model
disambiguation: Not a tool for writing or running 1C code; it only adds syntax coloring to code blocks.
extras: The README states the plugin was created with AI help and has not been thoroughly reviewed or tested; users are asked to report bugs. Instructions for manual installation and building from source are included.
problem: Obsidian cannot highlight 1C (BSL) code blocks, so code written in this Russian business-automation language renders as plain text.

relations.evidence: the token model matches the reference 1c-syntax grammar
based on the 1C language definitions from highlight.js (BSD-3-Clause) and Prism

summary: Syntax highlighting plugin that colors 1C:Enterprise (BSL) and OneScript code blocks in the editor and reading view.
